{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|But I can't learn to fly. Ever. When I go up in aircraft, even when I'm on a high balcony, I become dizzy. I panic. I can't think.|Cheriss ke Hanadi on her illness|<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
'''Vertigo''' was an ailment which caused dizziness and panic attacks when gazing down from a high altitude. It was treated by taking certain chemicals every few [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="soa" /> The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and explosives expert [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] suffered from vertigo, having experienced an intense episode that left him with a fear of spacewalking.<ref name="HerdHeist>{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
